$schema-note: Machine-readable CSP baseline for APP-01 browser (M1). A build/CI serializer (M1B) turns this into a Content-Security-Policy header string; a test asserts connect-src/script-src contain no forbidden token and connect-src holds only 'self' plus origins from the approved-endpoint set. See CSP_AND_SECURITY_HEADERS.md.

connect_src_policy.note: connect-src is the exfiltration boundary; only origins the user has explicitly approved AND that the served policy permits may be added. Wildcards/scheme-sources are rejected by the build test.

additional_headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
